description_en: Queries a list of devices based on device status
description_zh: 调用该接口根据设备状态查询设备列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-by-status --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --status 1 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfm4l5tcwd000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceByStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device status. Valid values:

- **0**: inactive.
- **1**: online.
- **3**: offline.
- **8**: disabled
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number from which to start displaying the results
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Specifies the number of records to display on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

><notice>Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The request parameter **ResourceGroupId** is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

><notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数**ResourceGroupId**配置已无效，无需再传入。
></notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id
